finalText:
**The build works now.** One real error, hiding under the noise:

```
ERROR EBUILD01 link-failed: src/core/settings.js — ReferenceError: retries is not defined
```

`resolveConfig` in `src/core/settings.js` read a bare `retries` that was never declared. It meant to read `retries` off the passed-in `env`. I changed it to `env.retries` and added a `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES` constant as the fallback the comment described.

Build exits 0 with 3 warnings. Those three point at `src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/utils/format.js`, and `src/core/graph.js` — none of those files exist here, so I could not touch them.
